elements.label: Figure 7.6
elements.title: Simple Perceptron Neural Network Model. Here, x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄ are the inputs, w₁, w₂, w₃, w₄ represent the weights, and b represents the bias. The output, or response, is y.
elements.summary: This diagram illustrates a simple perceptron neural network model with four inputs (x₁ to x₄), each multiplied by corresponding weights (w₁ to w₄), combined with a bias (b), and passed through a tanh activation function to produce the output y.
